description: This is a FastAPI-based backend API implementation for a resume screening application. It includes endpoints for uploading resumes, listing resumes, creating and listing criteria, ranking resumes against criteria, and listing ranked candidates. The code handles database interactions, JSON normalization, and scoring logic based on skills criteria.

methods.name: _normalize_db_json
methods.description: Normalizes database JSON/JSONB values to Python dicts, handling various types including strings and None.

methods.name: _resume_row_to_out
methods.description: Converts a database resume row into a ResumeOut object.

methods.name: _criteria_row_to_out
methods.description: Converts a database criteria row into a CriteriaOut object.

methods.name: _ranking_row_to_out
methods.description: Converts a database ranking row into a RankingOut object.

methods.name: _compute_score
methods.description: Calculates a simple score for a resume based on criteria JSON and extracted resume fields, considering skills and weights.
